# Bundled barcode encoders

- `bcmath-min.js` and `pdf417-min.js`: [bkuzmic/pdf417-js](https://github.com/bkuzmic/pdf417-js). The PDF417 file declares LGPLv3; the BC Math file declares LGPL. Their original source headers are retained.
- `qrcode.min.js`: [davidshimjs/qrcodejs](https://github.com/davidshimjs/qrcodejs), MIT license; see `qrcode-LICENSE.txt`.

These libraries generate images entirely in the browser. The barcode payload is never submitted to a remote barcode service.

This repository does not claim ownership of these libraries.
